BiblicalUsage: The word is a sale, and it appears once, in the law that forbids selling an Israelite as a slave: they are My servants, whom I brought out of Egypt, and they shall not be sold as bondmen.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the verse is the foundation of freedom: God bought His people out of Egypt, so no man may buy them back.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
